sources.title: Broncos sign veteran safety Taylor Rapp
sources.description: According to multiple reports, including ESPN’s lead NFL insider Adam Schefter, the Denver Broncos are signing veteran safety Taylor Rapp. To make room for Rapp on the roster, the Broncos have waived/injured linebacker Levelle Bailey, according to 9NEWS Denver’s Mike Klis.
